objective: Independently choose long, short or cash before each six-hour interval, settle the previous paper episode, review costs and forecast error, and train again using only completed observations.
information: Use closing prices available one hour before entry. Training labels must end no later than that information cutoff. At every decision use 360 nonoverlapping six-hour training episodes. Fit one local nearest-neighbor return estimator on trailing 6h, 24h and 72h returns and 24h volatility, normalized using the training sample alone. Use the 36 nearest past episodes. Estimate the signed six-hour return net of actual historical funding. Subtract a round trip at 0.06% taker plus 0.10% adverse price per side and one standard error of the neighbor returns before selecting a side. Otherwise remain in cash. Never replace the side with the later winning control.
capital: Single isolated 1000 USDT research account. Assign at most 40% of settled account equity per episode; use lot rules, actual depth for prospective fills and signed funding. Every open paper position must close and be reviewed before another opens. Never fabricate a missed entry or exit; report delayed closes separately. No exchange orders, private keys or paid models.
history: Use the final 28 complete weeks of the fixed historical archive. Two consecutive 14-week blocks, each initially funded at 1000 USDT. Compare cash and the exact reverse of the selected side after the same costs. Report every week, time in cash and contribution of funding, price movement and execution costs.
forward: First entry clock 2026-11-20 19:00 UTC. Run for 26 weeks. A prediction must be committed during the preceding hour, entry must be obtained within five minutes after the clock; catch up settlement after a restart. Prospective observations are an experiment even if historical returns are negative.
